description: Ministry of Local Government - Western Province - By Laws of Local Authority of the Seethawaka Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the notification and enactment of new by-laws (specifically "By-Law on the Maintenance of Laundry and Washing Places") by the Seethawakapura Urban Council under the Urban Council Ordinance. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and licensing procedures for laundry operations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
